items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 1:37-1:57 the page carries the whole sentence, '...is no fiction, and it seems I must so say.'; the film page's note says 'set as the magazine's page'.

items.title: Chapter 3: the torpedoes read as lamps; machines overlap in pairs
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 1:05-1:30 the new torpedoes rise level and dart off one after another, behind the two men; at 3:50 the far tier sits half a step over, no doubled pairs.

items.title: Chapter 2: footnote 1 is up too briefly to read
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 0:32-0:41 footnote 1 stays up about 9 s; footnote 2 about 3.5 s.

items.title: Read: the kicker calls it the 1961 text, though 16 readings are from 1932
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: the Read kicker reads 'From Amazing Stories, August 1932 · the 1961 reprint's text, 16 readings from 1932 restored'.

items.title: Does 'force-screen' sound right in ch04 0:12 (p037.2)? Whisper hears 'fourth'.
items.note: From the third fresh-eyes round's transcript check. Voicing is yours to judge by ear.

items.title: Does 'Last of Men' sound right in ch08 2:49 (p108.1)? Whisper hears 'blessed'.
items.note: From the third fresh-eyes round's transcript check. Voicing is yours to judge by ear.

items.title: Chapter 9: the red beam's duel with the white sphere doesn't read
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 2:20-2:40 the plant's top, the beam and the white sphere are held in one frame; the dull red beam grows out toward the sphere, which leaps into it and struggles, spraying, shrinking.

items.title: Chapter 6: the motes' last charge is invisible
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 3:52-4:10 the motes are larger with rings of flame, draw off and dart in at the giants as the camera rushes in.

items.title: Chapter 7: the dome is lost on the chapter's last line
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 4:13-4:25 the dome keeps a pale rim against the night and the pull-back stops at 0.55; the dome reads on the last line.

items.title: Chapter 7: the projectors' beams are faint and the fleet isn't shown driven off
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 4:01-4:11 the projectors' beams are wide and bright, striking the fleet in frame until it's gone.

items.title: Chapter 3: the fleet's slow approach is a still frame
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 1:31-1:47 fifteen ships in ranks close on the Moon, growing as they come, the camera easing toward them.

items.title: Film page: the 'deadly logic' note promises a picture the film doesn't show
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: ch08 4:20-4:27 a stepped ruled line draws from F-2 up to the plant's crown on 'the deadly logic', and a curl of pale wash rises beside it on 'the leaping intuition', as the note says.

items.title: The beings of force read as galaxies, with nothing to say what they are
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: the film page's narrator note now says the coloured spirals round F-2 are the beings of Force, 'those who are now', the heirs; their look stays Curt's call.

items.title: Chapter 9: Roal and Trest's last scene shows them as specks
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 4:18-4:27 the camera is in close on Roal and Trest, hands lifted in the ruby's warmth, before the pull-back.

items.title: Chapter 5: C-R-U-1's name runs past its case; a long still hold
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 7:40-7:54 C-R-U-1 centred on the pier's foot, its golden name inside the case, the camera pushing in.

items.title: Chapter 3: the torpedoes rise through the men's heads
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 1:10-1:16 the torpedoes rise behind the men and on above their heads.

items.title: Chapter 8: F-2's thought-rings sweep through Trest on a loop
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 2:43-3:47 F-2's thought-rings spread to 200 round it, short of Trest.

items.title: Chapter 5: the fallen F-1 lies half out of frame
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 4:52-5:02 the fallen F-1 lies whole in frame, Roal and the couch in frame too.

items.title: Chapter 2: the Outsider holds the projector before he 'appeared armed'
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: 4:39-4:42 the armed Outsider walks in from the right on 'appeared armed', then raises the projector.

items.title: Chapter 0: the title page's masthead and byline are small on a phone
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: ch00 0:08 the masthead (42 px) and byline (52 px) read, the rules widened.

items.title: The quality page's phone screenshot predates the page
items.note: Retaken after the round: the quality page's phone shot is rebuilt from the current scorecard (npm run quality, then the site, then the phone check), and shows 72 of 72 and 20 of 20.

fresh.note: Film and site, second round: a subagent with no context watched all twelve drafts (whole and close sheets, edge scan, loudness, transcripts) and checked every page live and at 375 px. 2 major (bare paper below the set in ch04 and others; the hall screens' ships not held in their screens), 6 minor, 8 nits; recorded as find.* items.

Film and site, third round: a subagent with no context watched all twelve drafts against the word timings and checked the site live. 2 major (ch02's investigator never hidden, its bluish beam invisible), 9 minor, 4 nits recorded as find.* items; 2 transcription flags put to Curt as voice items.

Film and site, fourth round: a subagent with no context watched all twelve drafts against the word times and checked the site live. No major findings: 8 minor, 7 nits, recorded as find.* items (the beings of force's look is Curt's call; the fix is a note).
